profile.headline: Software Engineer | Distributed Systems • Java • Cloud Architecture • Kubernetes
profile.summary:
A Fullstack Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience building distributed cloud systems, developer tooling, and internal platforms that improve reliability and scalability.

I specialize in distributed systems, having worked extensively with them throughout my career. I'm most engaged when solving difficult engineering problems, particularly when it comes to creating secure, reliable and performant systems.

Before software, I worked on nuclear submarines for the U.S Navy, completed a competitive software developer apprenticeship through Apprenti and also briefly volunteered as an EMT on weekends while continuing my career in tech.

Outside of work, I'm usually experimenting with new technologies, reading about distributed systems, or exploring advances in AI and cloud infrastructure.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and led development of Java Agents that extended our internal testing platform to support previously unsupported protocols, increasing coverage by over 50%.
- Building an internal production release diagnostics tool from the ground up that has significantly reduced production issues, saving time and money for our client.
- Owned development of backend services, internal tooling, and testing infrastructure supporting a distributed cloud platform.
- Developed backend APIs while designing and implementing frontend functionality for internal engineering tools, influencing
overall product usability and workflow.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Kubernetes · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Spring Boot · TypeScript · React.js · Splunk · Datadog

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Enterprise Architecture
- Participated in high-level architecture meetings with stakeholders and influenced decisions.
- Built greenfield internal applications with Java and Typescript.

Kepware
- Investigated, diagnosed and fixed production issues in industrial IoT software used directly on the factory floor. Reducing system downtime for affected customers.
- Maintained and enhanced a large legacy C++ codebase while implementing new product features.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) · TypeScript · React.js · Kubernetes

positions.title: Probationary Volunteer Emergency Medical Technician
positions.description:
- Responded to emergency medical calls in high-pressure environments requiring rapid decision making, teamwork, and clear communication.
- Volunteered on weekends while also working full-time as a Software Engineer.
- Had to resign from my position as my family and I relocated from New Hampshire to Maine.

positions.title: Apprentice
positions.description: Was a member of the first cohort of software development apprentices out of the Massachusetts chapter of Apprenti.

positions.title: Pipefitter
positions.description:
- Worked in high-risk industrial environments where precision, safety, and communication were critical.
- Earned and maintained a Secret Clearance while supporting maintenance and modernization of U.S. Navy nuclear submarines.
